analysis: MERGE_CHECKS item 2: nominal-point derivative feasibility gate, implementation only
status: statistics and control flow corrected; real-executor preflight submitted; the gate itself has NOT run
what_it_decides: whether the eta derivatives are computable at all, and what the nuisance study would cost. It is evaluated at the nominal point and runs zero draws.

entry_points.transport: --run only, and it calls require_citation_gate_open first
entry_points.no_bypass: a self-test inspects the argument parser rather than the source text and asserts the exposed options are exactly --selftest, --dry-run, --run, --replicates and --photons, with no force, skip, ignore or allow flag
entry_points.verified_hard_fail: --run exits 1 with REFUSING to run transport while the gate is closed

per_column_declarations.units_and_coordinates: every eta parameter declares units and a coordinate; all six are dimensionless because the positive quantities are carried in log
per_column_declarations.bounds_are_feasibility_limits_not_priors: beyond them the layer stack or the scattering would stop being physical, so the gate refuses rather than evaluates
per_column_declarations.step_grid_is_shared: eta is dimensionless, so a step is a fractional change in the underlying quantity and one grid serves every column
per_column_declarations.moderate_steps_only: the h to zero limit degenerates to the pathwise derivative under common random numbers, which is the thing being tested

refusal_not_clamping: an infeasible point is refused with a stated reason. Clamping would quietly change the step size and corrupt the extrapolation.

estimator_support.why: the replay kernel accumulates per-layer pathlength and the escaping weight is w0 exp(-sum_j mua_j L_j), so its moments give absorption derivatives and nothing else. Only the melanin column is an absorber; the three thickness and two scattering columns are not differentiable this way.
estimator_support.route_for_unsupported: AD against an ensemble central difference with independent replicate streams and an h^2 extrapolation, the estimator-independent reference item 1 used

why_the_thickness_columns_are_suspect: a layer boundary position enters the kernel through a searchsorted layer index and through the distance-to-interface comparison, both discrete branches that MOVE with the parameter. The pathwise derivative drops the boundary term those branches generate, which is the same mechanism that makes common-random-number finite differences unable to validate pathwise AD. A thickness derivative taken by AD is therefore suspect by construction and must be demonstrated, not assumed.
convergence_rule: converged when the three-term minus two-term difference stays below three replicate standard errors, so the h^2 fit is limited by noise and not by truncation
agreement_rule: AD is accepted for a column when it sits within three standard errors of the ensemble reference. A column that fails is routed to the ensemble difference, which is the expected outcome for a pathwise derivative that drops a moving-boundary term.

cost_projection.no_pmc_term: no eta column is a pMC-supported absorption column this round
cost_projection.basis: forward at 126.6 s measured in the item 1 pilot at 200000 photons per wavelength over four wavelengths. A five-column eta jacfwd is taken as about five forward evaluations, 640 s, and the eleven-column theta jacobian as 744 s scaled from the six-column 372 s measurement. Both are projections and the gate measures them.
cost_projection.status: projection; the gate replaces every term with a measurement

cost_finding: the gate itself is 9.51 hours. The 48-draw study is 9.92 hours if AD holds on every column, 90.94 with one ensemble column, 252.99 with the three thickness columns, which are the suspect ones, and 415.04 if all five fail. The gate replaces every term with a measurement.

groups.core: 44, gate-state independent, including the simultaneous test, the paired convergence denominator, the hard gate and the runner through a mocked executor
groups.end to end, mocked: 7, including the unconverged case that must refuse

two_selftest_errors_found_and_fixed.melanosome_bound: the first version asserted that an in-bounds point could trigger the fraction guard. It cannot: the bound already makes the guard unreachable. The test now asserts the edge is feasible, beyond it is refused, and the guard is redundant by construction, which is what is actually true.
two_selftest_errors_found_and_fixed.bypass_search: the first version searched its own source for override flag names, which contains those names as literals in the test, so it reported a bypass that does not exist. It now inspects the argument parser instead.

no_longer_a_placeholder: --run previously raised SystemExit immediately after the gate check, so the transport path was a stub. build_executor now constructs the production forward model under an eta perturbation and run_gate performs the column-by-column measurement. The gate is still checked BEFORE the executor is constructed, so a closed gate never imports the transport stack.

executor.built_from: the production forward solver forward_y_multi_layer, with the layer stack from boundaries_from_eta, the reduced scattering scaled per wavelength by mus_factor_from_eta, and the production psi held at nominal
executor.pmc_route: src/replay_kernel.replay_moments, used only for the one absorber column
executor.refuses_infeasible_eta: the executor itself re-checks the point and raises before any transport, so a planner oversight cannot slip a bad point through

runner_records_per_column_per_h_per_repl: R_plus and R_minus full observable vectors at every step size
the difference quotients, which a self-test confirms follow exactly from the stored arrays
the seed, drawn as seed_base + 7919 r
an array_sha256 digest over the stored arrays, which a self-test recomputes
the pMC moment shape and digest where pMC applies
failure_semantics: the result artifact is written only after every column returns. A transport failure propagates and leaves no artifact, which a self-test verifies by injecting a failure on the fifth reflectance call and confirming the output path is untouched.

mocked_executor_selftests.released_test_spec_enters_executor: with a test copy of the spec whose citations are marked verified, the runner makes 6 x 3 x 2 x 4 = 144 reflectance calls across six columns and 3 pMC calls, one per replicate on the single supported column

nan_warning_fixed: the dry run previously called column_convergence on an all-zero array purely to obtain the rule string, which produced an All-NaN RuntimeWarning. The rule is now a module constant, CONVERGENCE_RULE, and the dry run no longer invokes the convergence routine at all. Verified with RuntimeWarning promoted to an error.

control_flow_fix.problem: selftest hard-asserted that the citation gate must be closed, so once the spec was released main --run would have called selftest and failed on its own success condition
control_flow_fix.fix: self-tests are split into selftest_core, which is gate-state independent and is the only group --run calls, selftest_gate_policy, which tests the closed and released states separately, and selftest_end_to_end, which drives main --run itself
control_flow_fix.end_to_end_goes_through_main: the previous mocked test called run_gate directly, which would not have caught this. The new one injects a released spec through a module hook, invokes main(), and asserts it passes through the factory and the runner and writes the artifact

spec_override_is_not_a_cli_flag: the end-to-end test needs main() to see a released spec, but a --spec flag would have been a bypass: anyone could hand-write a released spec and point production at it. The override is a module-level hook with no command-line surface, and a self-test asserts --spec does not exist

real_ad_comparison.how: refl_eta takes eta as a jnp array and builds the layer stack with jnp.diff, jnp.exp, at[].multiply and jnp.cumsum, and the scattering factor with jnp.exp and a jnp power. No np.asarray, no float() and no Python list conversion appears inside it
real_ad_comparison.why_it_matters: any of those would freeze eta into a constant and make jacfwd silently return zeros for the geometry columns, which is exactly the failure this gate exists to detect
real_ad_comparison.jacobian: jax.jacfwd over the five eta columns, one Jacobian per replicate serving every column
real_ad_comparison.comparison: paired against the h^2-extrapolated ensemble reference replicate by replicate, since they share photon keys inside a replicate
real_ad_comparison.route_decision: each column's verdict sets estimator_route_for_the_study, so the gate output really decides the study's estimator per column. ad_compared is true and the artifact carries estimator_routes_for_the_study

rounding_floor_bug_found_by_the_mocked_r.symptom: the mocked AD is the exact derivative of the mock response, so the paired difference against the reference was pure rounding, yet the comparison returned a confident z of 39.8 and routed every column to the ensemble method
rounding_floor_bug_found_by_the_mocked_r.cause: the paired mean and its standard error were both at the 1e-16 level and their ratio is arbitrary. Dividing one rounding number by another produced a verdict out of noise.
rounding_floor_bug_found_by_the_mocked_r.fix: ROUNDING_RELATIVE_FLOOR of 1e-12 relative to the quantity's own magnitude. A component whose paired standard error does not clear that floor is decided on its mean instead of a ratio: negligible means exact agreement, anything larger means a genuine constant offset and an infinite z.
rounding_floor_bug_found_by_the_mocked_r.same_guard_as_item_1: the radial pilot needed the same kind of floor for the same reason, and it would have mattered on real data too, where a column whose AD happens to be right would have been rejected
selftests_added: a paired scatter at rounding level is not turned into a confident disagreement
a constant offset above the floor is still caught despite zero scatter

pmc_removed_this_round.why: with melanin gone, three eta columns move layer boundaries and two move scattering. The replay kernel accumulates per-layer pathlength and the escaping weight is w0 exp(-sum_j mua_j L_j), so its moments give absorption derivatives and nothing else: it supports neither geometry nor scattering derivatives.
pmc_removed_this_round.no_success_phrasing: no output says pMC was used; every column records pmc_used false with the reason
pmc_removed_this_round.still_right_for_psi: the six psi columns are absorption columns and pMC does support them; that is item 1 and is unaffected

no_unimplemented_branches: grep over the script finds no TODO, FIXME, NotImplemented, placeholder or unreachable marker. The only path that does not execute is the real transport inside build_executor, which is blocked by the gate rather than unwritten, and the mocked end-to-end test exercises the control flow around it.

1_convergence_is_a_hard_gate.before: a column could be reported as not converged and still receive an AD comparison, an estimator route and a place in a success artifact
1_convergence_is_a_hard_gate.after: an unconverged column gets ad_comparison null, ad_compared false, estimator_route_for_the_study null and status unresolved, and main --run raises REFUSING to write a feasibility result with a nonzero exit and writes nothing
1_convergence_is_a_hard_gate.end_to_end_test: a mock with a strong quartic term makes all five columns fail convergence, and the test asserts main --run refuses and leaves no artifact

2_paired_convergence_denominator.before: the truncation diagnostic divided by SE(e2)
2_paired_convergence_denominator.after: it divides by the paired standard error of e3 - e2
2_paired_convergence_denominator.why: the two fits share the same difference quotients, so their difference is far less noisy than either one and SE(e2) understates the truncation. This is the same mistake item 1 made with an unpaired denominator.
2_paired_convergence_denominator.non_finite_and_unsupported: a non-finite paired difference BLOCKS the comparison rather than being dropped, and a component whose reference magnitude is at or below 1e-12 of the column's largest is excluded by a pre-registered rule and counted. Neither is silently ignored.

3_simultaneous_comparison.before: mean over standard error compared to a fixed threshold of 3, per component
3_simultaneous_comparison.after: max-T over the column's components, calibrated by EXACT sign-flip randomization over all 2^n replicate sign patterns, at a pre-registered alpha of 0.05
3_simultaneous_comparison.why: 120 components on 6 replicates means 120 t statistics on 5 degrees of freedom, which exceed 3 somewhere with probability near one. A self-test shows pure noise putting 3 of 120 components past t = 3 while max-T returns p = 0.59 and does not reject.
3_simultaneous_comparison.resolution_floor: with 6 replicates the null has 64 points, so no p below 1/64 = 0.0156 is attainable, and that floor is recorded with every verdict

two_cases_the_randomization_test_cannot_.rounding_level: a component whose paired standard error is at rounding level cannot enter the test, because sign-flipping a zero-variance difference leaves it unchanged. It is decided on its mean: negligible is exact agreement.
two_cases_the_randomization_test_cannot_.deterministic_offset: zero scatter with a mean above the rounding floor is a disagreement no randomization null can explain, so it is reported directly rather than laundered through a p value. Sign-flipping alone would have returned p = 1 for it.

3_simultaneous_comparison.symmetry_assumption: sign-flip calibration assumes the paired differences are symmetric about zero under the null, which holds for a difference of two estimators sharing exchangeable replicate noise

5_real_executor_preflight.why: the mocked self-tests exercise control flow and statistics against an analytic response and establish nothing about transport. Describing 44 of 44 mocked checks as verifying the real executor would have been wrong.
5_real_executor_preflight.what_it_does: compiles the traced eta path on the target hardware and checks that at eta = 0 the reflectance reproduces the production forward solver called DIRECTLY with the same keys, with nothing from this module in the path, so a reordered layer or a misapplied scale shows up. It also checks that the AD column norms are nonzero for the three geometry and two scattering columns, since a frozen eta would make jacfwd return exactly zero there.
5_real_executor_preflight.cost: 2000 photons per wavelength, minutes rather than hours
5_real_executor_preflight.gate_relationship: it validates code rather than priors, so it does not require the citation gate, and it cannot write the gate artifact: --out is rejected for it
5_real_executor_preflight.spec_records: executor_verification_status says the mocked self-tests do NOT verify the real executor and that the preflight is required before the gate runs

mocked_selftests_do_not_verify_the_real_: 60 of 60 mocked checks verify control flow, statistics and artifact handling against an analytic response. They are not evidence about transport. That is what the preflight is for.

all_five_columns_blocked.statement: every column reported outcome 'blocked', which is NOT a measurement that the h^2 extrapolation truncates too much. 'blocked' means the degenerate-spread guard declined to issue a verdict. The gate measured nothing about convergence for these columns.

root_cause_is_mine.defect: two thresholds that are each defensible in isolation interact badly on a radially binned observable. DEGENERATE_SPREAD_FRACTION compares a component's absolute replicate standard deviation against 0.05 of the COLUMN MEDIAN standard deviation, which assumes the components share a scale. These columns span 7.5 to 10.0 decades of dynamic range, so the outermost radial bins have a genuinely tiny absolute spread because their signal is tiny, and the guard reads that as a collapsed sample. SUPPORT_RELATIVE_FLOOR of 1e-12 times the largest magnitude is far too permissive to remove them: it excluded 0 of 120 components for four of the five columns.
root_cause_is_mine.evidence: every degenerate-spread component in all five columns sits below 1e-4 of the column maximum, and not one sits above 1e-2. The guard fires exclusively in the noise floor and never on a signal-carrying component.
root_cause_is_mine.introduced_in: the fix for the Bonferroni collapse under a near-discrete law, which was calibrated on a homogeneous-scale simulation

a_second_and_independent_problem.statement: fixing the thresholds alone would not produce a pass. Restricted to the components carrying more than 1e-3 of the column maximum, the POINT ESTIMATE of the relative truncation |e3 - e2| / |reference| already exceeds the 5 percent margin for four of the five columns, and the simultaneous upper confidence bound is wider than the point estimate.
a_second_and_independent_problem.reading: the step grid (0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1) is in the wrong regime for the h^2 extrapolation. The three thickness columns are the worst, which is what the design predicted from the moving-boundary term the pathwise derivative drops. log_mus_scale is the only column whose top-stratum point estimate stays under the margin.
a_second_and_independent_problem.status: POST HOC and DESCRIPTIVE. Computed from the stored data after seeing the gate fail. It is not a verdict, no threshold was tuned to produce it, and it must not be reported as a convergence result.

formal_run_62960056.the_transport_is_not_lost: results/nuisance_feasibility_gate_BLOCKED.json preserves every per-replicate difference quotient, every R_plus and R_minus, and every AD Jacobian. The convergence and equivalence analysis can be redone entirely offline with no new transport. Re-analysing this same data under changed thresholds is a post-hoc adjustment and must be pre-registered as such before it is applied, not decided after seeing which choice passes.

measured_costs.note: the AD jacobian is 2.6 times cheaper than the design assumed; the forward cost matched within 2 percent

formal_run_62960056.estimator_routes_selected: none. Every column is None, because no column was adjudicated.

1_the_withdrawn_rule_still_controlled_th.defect: simultaneous_equivalence_test still returned early on degenerate.any() with outcome 'unresolved'. Setting blocked to False and calling the count a diagnostic did not withdraw the rule's behavioural effect: it still prevented equivalence.
1_the_withdrawn_rule_still_controlled_th.fix: the conditional return is removed. The count is computed for reporting and no branch reads it: it does not affect support, the critical value, the bounds or the outcome.
1_the_withdrawn_rule_still_controlled_th.test_replaced: the old test asserted DEGENERATE_SPREAD_IS_A_BLOCKING_CRITERION is False, which a rule still in control would satisfy. It is replaced by a BEHAVIOURAL scale-invariance test: 90 single-component rescalings by 1e-9, 1e-6 and 1e3 over 30 datasets must leave the outcome and both bounds unchanged. The implementation passes it only after the conditional return was removed.
1_the_withdrawn_rule_still_controlled_th.suspension_now_data_independent: require_registered_interval_criterion reads nominal_derivative_feasibility_gate.interval_criterion_registration and refuses BEFORE any data is read or any executor is built. A data-triggered suspension is indistinguishable from a verdict, which is the thing being withdrawn.
1_the_withdrawn_rule_still_controlled_th.documentation: every remaining claim that the guard blocks the near-discrete mechanism is corrected. The 0.0283 coverage shortfall is now stated as UNGUARDED.

2_the_diagnostic_now_reproduces_the_gate.what_i_had_reported: five of five unresolved at the 10 percent floor. That was wrong, and both errors above caused it.
2_the_diagnostic_now_reproduces_the_gate.this_does_not_authorize_the_floor: the 10 percent floor retains 4 to 13 of 120 components and is about twice as aggressive as MIN_COUNT=5, which already moves the deep bound 26.6 percent.

Replicates shrink s/sqrt(n) and cannot shrink |mean|, which is finite-difference truncation bias. More replicates would establish INEQUIVALENCE for those columns.
